subject: Caleb Nguyen — interview debrief and score-gap triage
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Caleb Nguyen — interview debrief & missing score

Hi team,

Thanks for taking the loop yesterday on Caleb Nguyen (SWE - Inference). I pulled the scorecards we have so far and there are a couple of gaps before we can make a decision:

- Marissa (me): System design 7, Coding 8, Culture 7 — attached (CalebNguyen-Scorecard-Marissa.pdf)
- Laura: I only see your note but not the numeric system-design score in Greenhouse; can you confirm?
- Neha: coordinating next steps / potential follow-up if needed.

Quick ask: if everyone can reply with a final numeric score for system design and 1–2 bullets on risk areas by EOD today, I will consolidate and ping Aditya if we need a tie-break. We want to close next-step and be clear to Neha on whether we move to final onsite or a short take-home.

Attachments: CalebNguyen-Resume.pdf, CalebNguyen-Scorecard-Marissa.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Engineer, Core Serving
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jul 2025 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Caleb Nguyen — interview debrief & missing score

> Hi team,
> 
> Thanks for taking the loop yesterday on Caleb Nguyen (SWE - Inference). I pulled the scorecards we have so far and there are a couple of gaps before we can make a decision:

> - Marissa (me): System design 7, Coding 8, Culture 7 — attached (CalebNguyen-Scorecard-Marissa.pdf)
> - Laura: I only see your note but not the numeric system-design score in Greenhouse; can you confirm?

Sorry for the omission — I filed notes but forgot to enter the numeric. My score: System design 6.

Notes (high level):
- Strong debugging and ownership examples; weak on distributed KV-store tradeoffs for cold-start.
- Concern: limited experience with request aggregation patterns at scale — would need senior bump or pairing early on.

Attached my short notes (LauraBennett-Notes-Caleb.docx).

Laura
Engineering Manager, Serving
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jul 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Caleb Nguyen — interview debrief & missing score

Thanks for the quick updates. For context, Caleb is eager and available for a final on-site the week of July 14 if we choose to move forward.

If the panel lands near a split decision we can either:
- Bring him for the final loop (PM + infra lead) — longer but higher signal, or
- Give a focused take-home focused on request batching & caching design (3–4 hours) to address the distribution tradeoff concern Laura flagged.

I don't need a final answer right this second, but a consolidated pass/reject + main risk bullet will help me set expectations.

-Neha
Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Caleb Nguyen — interview debrief & missing score

Quick nudge — thanks for the scores. My read: coding + culture are fine; system design is the marginal area. Two practical options from a hiring-cadence POV:

1) Move to final panel if at least two internal folks mark >=7 on system design.
2) If split (one >=7, others 6), ask for the 3–4h take-home focused on aggregation/caching.

If Jonas wants me to be tie-breaker I can weigh in, but I'd prefer the take-home if we're ambiguous — faster to evaluate on the exact risk.

-Aditya
Director, Engineering
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Caleb Nguyen — interview debrief & missing score

Thanks all for the quick turn. Consolidated summary below (pulling from notes and attachments):

- System design: Marissa 7, Laura 6, Jonas (self, listened in) 7 — consolidated median = 7
- Coding: Marissa 8, Jonas 8 — strong enough
- Culture / role fit: generally positive; some onboarding risk noted by Laura

Decision: Move candidate to final panel (PM + infra lead) w/ one follow-up prep item for the interviewers to probe request aggregation and cold-start mitigation (Aditya, can you own the infra question set?), rather than requesting a take-home. This preserves momentum (candidate available week of Jul 14) and gives direct signal.

Action items:
- Aditya: prepare 3 targeted questions around aggregation/caching and cold-start to use in final panel (due Wed Jul 9).
- Neha: lock final panel for week of Jul 14 and notify Caleb; include prep note that we will focus on request aggregation and cold-start use cases.
- Marissa/Laura: bring any specific clarifying questions into the panel.
- I will update the Greenhouse packet and attach Laura's notes.

Related links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gZ_example_debrief_doc (consolidated notes), HR-Tracker-ID: HIRE-2025-3421

Jonas Weber
Staff Engineer, Serving
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
